conclusions.finding: ExecutionProfile documents aggregate nested stages and a non-recursively-added outer total.
Actual OneLoop evaluate_batch invocation is enclosed in scalar_masters timing; scatter/result inspections follow the stopped stage.
Actual E6 evaluate_batch including internal quadrature/D0 invokes the same scalar_masters timer.
Checked-regular lowpoint/MassTaylor child profiles are summed after actual child reduction.
Packed lowpoint, MassTaylor and recursive AffinePower child profiles are summed exactly once after actual reductions.
Imported parent Workspace profile is summed; its imported master leaves do not trigger new E6 work.

ImportedAffineQuadrature::evaluate propagates already-computed errors; source at stability/quadrature/imported_affine.rs:123 contains coefficient and positive Symbolica evaluator calls, no scalar-master evaluator. Its time belongs in TIRust-exclusive overhead.
MassTaylor adds unit and projection profile stages rather than entire recursively overlapping totals.

Profiling disallows eligible thin wrappers and selects the existing AffinePower workspace for coordinate positive-power N>=6 requests. Report must name actual profiled path; no default-thin timing claim.

formula: exclusive_ns = outer_reduce_batch_wall_ns - aggregate_nested_scalar_masters_ns; same-call arithmetic means additive
